messages:
rafael: originating RC-2026.crossreg for the EU->NA rollout window. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/rcs/rc-crossreg-2026.tgz. requesting pin and cross-region capacity check

deploy-bot: build rc-crossreg-2026 (b-2033) uploaded :package: artifact s3://redwood-ci/rcs/rc-crossreg-2026.tgz sha256=9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b

meera: pulling to staging EU, will run verify + quick smoke. note: this RC includes a quantized model variant (q4) and a full fp16 variant; plan to serve q4 in NA if Dedicated capacity constrained.

shawn: pinging infra for NA dedicated pool headroom for tomorrow's window (we need at least 40 GPUs free across regions for warm pools). @infra

infra: NA pool headroom currently 28 GPUs free (below target). autoscale policy shows cooldown and quota limit in project org. Can request temporary burst but need approval from cloud-quotas team.

rafael: thanks. creating pin but marking "requires infra-burst" in description. pin-id will be used for staged promote once we have quota signoff.

deploy-bot: pin created by rafael -> pin-id: pin-rc-6573. status: PENDING_PROMOTE.

meera: staging verify: sha matches, smoke 12/12 passed. q4 model loaded in staging and passes latency checks.

rafael: moving forward with two-step plan: 1) sanity promote to EU prod canary (2% 15m). 2) if NA capacity insufficient at step, route NA to q4 fallback variant and notify product. Approving EU canary now.

/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6573 --canary 2% --canary-duration 15m --region eu-west-1 --tag rc-crossreg-2026
deploy-bot: Promotion started in eu-west-1. canary nodes: 6. routing active.

[6m into EU canary]

meera: EU canary looks healthy. p50 latency stable, error rate 0.05%.

rafael: attempting NA pool warm and reserve now. requesting infra burst.

infra: requested quota bump for NA GPU pool; cloud team response ETA 25m. current autoscaler cannot provision additional nodes due to quota.

shawn: because quota delay, plan to route NA traffic to q4 model on existing capacity. I want an explicit opt-in and an immediate rollback plan in case q4 quality regressions observed. @product will we accept temporary q4 fallback?

meera: q4 fallback is enabled by default via routing policy `model:fallback=q4` in promote command, but we should announce to product and ops.

rafael: notifying product; issuing promote with `--region na-prod --fallback q4` to start routing once EU canary OK.

/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6573 --canary 2% --canary-duration 15m --region na-prod --fallback q4
deploy-bot: Attempting NA canary promotion. Error: insufficient capacity to provision canary hosts in na-prod (requested 4 GPUs, available 2). Applying fallback policy: routing to q4 variant on existing hosts.

meera: telemetry shows q4 responses come back faster but with slightly lower quality score on eval metric (delta -2.5 BLEU-like). error rate nominal.

product: accepted temporary fallback but requests alerting on any quality delta >3.0. we are within threshold but monitor closely.

oncall-sheriff: standing by on NA canary. abort conditions: sudden error rate >0.7% OR quality metric delta >3.0 OR model OOM on q4 variant.

[10m into combined canaries]

meera: EU canary still green. NA q4 fallback showing small uptick in 5xxs on one host: investigating logs.

meera: logs indicate preloader hitting memory limit on host na-1 when switching to q4 with specific prompt shapes; container restarted once and recovered. no OOMKilled recorded yet.

oncall-sheriff: hold further ramp. do not increase traffic until na-1 reprovisioned or excluded. preparing abort if repeats.

shawn: removing na-1 from rotation and rebalancing q4 requests across remaining hosts. issuing command to exclude host:
`/deploy host remove --host na-1 --reason 'preloader mem limit'`

/deploy-bot: host na-1 removed. q4 routing redistributed. overall error rate returns to baseline.

rafael: EU canary completed 15m with no issues. promoting EU to 100% for region; NA will remain on q4 fallback until quota bump. issuing final promote steps for EU and leaving NA controlled.

/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6573 --region eu-west-1 --promote-to=region-full
deploy-bot: EU promotion to region-full completed. EU services now running rc-crossreg-2026.

meera: marking RC as PARTIALLY_PROMOTED (EU full, NA q4 fallback). updating release board and release notes: include note about temporary q4 fallback in NA and expected rollback after capacity bump.

infra: cloud quota bump approved (25m after request). scheduling NA additional node provisioning now.

shawn: once NA provisioned, plan: re-deploy na-prod with fp16 variant, run a small 1% canary for 20m, compare quality metrics, then flip routing. pre-approve rollback to q4 if metrics regress.

[after provisioning]
deploy-bot: NA pool provisioned: 28 GPUs added.

shawn: executing canary flip to fp16 variant in NA:
`/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6573 --region na-prod --canary 1% --canary-duration 20m --variant fp16`
deploy-bot: NA canary started on fp16 variant. canary hosts: 3

[12m into NA canary]

meera: quality metric delta vs q4: +1.8 (improvement). latency within SLA. no OOMs.

oncall-sheriff: good. proceed with ramp to 25% then full if metrics hold.

rafael: ramping NA to 25% now. monitoring.

deploy-bot: NA ramp to 25% complete.

[after checks]

meera: NA checks good. promoting NA to full.

/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6573 --region na-prod --promote-to=region-full --variant fp16
deploy-bot: NA full promotion complete. rc-crossreg-2026 is now serving fp16 in both regions.

rafael: marking RC as PROMOTED. adding notes: initial q4 fallback used for NA during quota shortfall; no customer-visible degradation beyond small quality delta within thresholds. filing a short post-release note and closing thread.

oncall-sheriff: closing - will keep watch on alerts for next 2h. great coordination :tada:
